analysis.inspected_by: agent (GitHub Copilot, session B) using the reference-analyst workflow
analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), the transitions sheet (all 4 boundaries, every 2nd frame = 30 fps for this 60 fps file) and the listen sheet (12 accent hits at -0.1/0/+0.1 s); automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; Windows desktop dictation for speech; nothing was listened to).
analysis.coverage: Full 15.0 s; the cut, the letter drop, the topple and the wipe at 30 fps; every listed accent checked against its frame.

concept.observed: A launch for a construction-estimating product drawn as pencil sketches on warm paper: a teal ball bounces down sketched stairs to a 'your firm' label, documents gather round it with hand-written notes, a cut inverts the page to a dark chalkboard, a headline's letters fall into place, the ball becomes its full stop, the letters topple, the ball draws a growth curve past a 'ceiling', bars wipe back to paper, and the ball rolls into the logo.
concept.interpreted: One protagonist object carries the viewer through every scene; the paper and chalkboard registers separate the problem from the payoff.

communication_style.observed: Hand-written annotations with arrows; one heavy condensed headline; no voice.

palette.observed: Warm off-white paper with pencil-grey lines and one teal accent; a dark green-black chalkboard section (5.0-11.4 s); mean luma 0.59 (57% light, 42% dark).

typography.observed: Hand-written annotation script; heavy condensed sans headline with an offset shadow; serif tagline in the end card.

shapes_and_materials.observed: Pencil sketches with hatching, paper texture, a sticky note, paper documents.

motion.observed: The ball squashes on each bounce (0.56, 0.81, 1.04 s); cards slide and settle; letters drop with a small bounce (6.78-7.06 s) and topple with rotation (8.81-9.14 s); the ball draws an S-curve (10.05-10.88 s).

transitions.observed: Four boundaries plus in-place changes. 5.00 s: hard cut that keeps the whole layout and inverts it from paper to chalkboard (cut, figure-ground match). 6.94 s: the headline's letters drop in one by one from above over 0.3 s (6.78-7.06 s; continuous). 8.97 s: the letters topple and fall out of frame with rotation over 0.33 s (8.81-9.14 s; continuous). 11.37 s: horizontal bars of random length and position cover the chalkboard and uncover paper in 0.3 s (11.21-11.51 s; cover). Not detected: 2.6-4.6 s documents slide in around the ball, 9.2-9.4 s chart axes draw, 12.4-13.1 s the ball rolls into the lockup (all continuous).
transitions.interpreted: The two hard-edged changes (the inversion cut and the bar wipe) enter and leave the payoff section; everything else moves inside a scene.

sound_design.observed: -14.2 LUFS, LRA 1.7 LU, true peak -2.4 dBTP; tempo estimate 118 bpm (low); 13 accents (52/min): on the three bounce contacts (0.56, 0.81, 1.04 s), the hand-written label (1.81 s), documents landing (2.04, 2.55, 2.72 s), then on a 1.00 s grid at x.05 s, each on an arrival: the last letter lands (7.06 s), the ball becomes the full stop (8.06 s), the curve starts (10.05 s) and tops out at the check (11.05 s). 0 of 4 boundaries carry an accent (chance 0.16); 1 of 4 within 50 ms of an onset (chance 0.35); no silences; head +0.8 dB, tail -1.8 dB. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Sound on contacts and arrivals; none on the cut or the wipe.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 0 words (15 raw words) over music.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: None. Hand-written annotations sit next to the object they name, with curved arrows (1.8-4.6 s and 9.4-10.9 s); one centred headline in the dark section.

motifs.observed: The teal ball: protagonist, full stop, pen and logo element.

scenes.observed: The ball bounces down sketched stairs.
Documents and hand-written notes gather around the ball.
Chalkboard negative: the ball glows and stretches.
Headline letters drop in; the ball becomes the full stop.
Chart: a flat 'ceiling', then the ball draws a rising curve.
The ball rolls into the logo; end card with tagline and address.

moments.observed: Hard cut: the same layout (documents, ball, sticky note) flips from pencil-on-paper to a dark chalkboard negative; the ball starts to glow.
moments.interpreted: A figure-ground swap says 'now look closer' without moving anything.

moments.observed: The ball drops into the end of the headline as its full stop, with an accent on the 1 s grid.
